_template: document-registry.json — master index of all documents created during the engagement. Written by the author agent at task completion; verified by the EM.
_description_format: The description field must be SUBSTANTIVE — 3-4 sentences explaining what the document actually says (not just the topic), followed by 3-4 bullet points with the key findings, numbers, or conclusions. A reader should be able to decide whether to open the file based on the description alone. Target ~6-10 lines. Short descriptions ('Analysis of market') are useless and force batch-reading of all documents later.
